cases.title: Runtime version remains a string
cases.target: Static types describe the Node runtime value without changing it.
cases.principledRepair: Keep the runtime string and parse only the component the program needs.
cases.weakRepair: Assert that process.version is a number.

cases.title: Runtime string assigned to a number
cases.target: The declaration for process.version is string.
cases.principledRepair: Declare version as string, then validate and convert a selected component.
cases.weakRepair: Use `as unknown as number`, which changes only the checker story.

cases.title: Satisfies checks a package-shaped value
cases.target: `satisfies` checks compatibility while retaining useful literal information.
cases.principledRepair: Use `satisfies` when the value should keep its inferred literal shape.
cases.weakRepair: Annotate everything as `Record<string, unknown>`, erasing useful information.

cases.title: Type-only import used as a runtime value
cases.target: Type-only imports are erased and cannot supply runtime values.
cases.principledRepair: Import a runtime value when one exists, or use the imported name only in type positions.
cases.weakRepair: Disable verbatim module syntax and depend on ambiguous import elision.

cases.title: Type annotations erase before execution
cases.target: TypeScript annotations do not exist in emitted JavaScript.
cases.principledRepair: Use types to check source relationships and runtime code to produce behavior.
cases.weakRepair: Expect interfaces to perform runtime validation.

cases.title: Unsafe assertion at an external boundary
cases.target: A type assertion does not validate parsed JSON.
cases.principledRepair: Parse as unknown and validate that port is a finite integer before use.
cases.weakRepair: Add optional chaining and silently continue without a valid configuration.

cases.title: Top-level await in an ESM module
cases.target: ESM supports top-level await under the selected module target.
cases.principledRepair: Keep top-level await at a deliberate module boundary.
cases.weakRepair: Wrap every module in an unnecessary async IIFE.

cases.title: Nonexistent named Node export
cases.target: Built-in module declarations define the available named exports.
cases.principledRepair: Import a real documented export or implement the required local function.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the entire imported module to any.

cases.title: Restricted decimal parsing
cases.target: Conversion follows an explicit acceptance grammar.
cases.principledRepair: Validate syntax and numeric range before returning the value.
cases.weakRepair: Rely only on `Number(raw)` and accept empty strings or exponent notation.

cases.title: String concatenation mistaken for arithmetic
cases.target: The `+` result is string when one operand is string.
cases.principledRepair: Parse raw under an explicit numeric policy before addition.
cases.weakRepair: Assert the concatenated string is a number.

cases.title: Object.is exposes special number semantics
cases.target: NaN and signed zero have deliberate equality behavior.
cases.principledRepair: Choose equality according to the product rule, not habit.
cases.weakRepair: Use loose equality to blur representation differences.

cases.title: Unchecked property after null JSON
cases.target: A JSON value can be null even when an assertion claims an object.
cases.principledRepair: Treat parsed data as unknown and reject null before property access.
cases.weakRepair: Catch the TypeError and replace the configuration with arbitrary defaults.

cases.title: Indexed access can be absent
cases.target: `noUncheckedIndexedAccess` includes undefined for an unchecked index.
cases.principledRepair: Check the result or use an operation whose contract guarantees an element.
cases.weakRepair: Use a non-null assertion without proving the collection is nonempty.

cases.title: Guarded indexed access
cases.target: A local undefined check narrows the indexed value.
cases.principledRepair: Narrow the retrieved value once and use that binding.
cases.weakRepair: Index the array repeatedly and scatter non-null assertions.

cases.title: Truthiness does not choose a union member
cases.target: Both nonempty strings and nonzero numbers are truthy.
cases.principledRepair: Use `typeof input === "string"` when the branch requires a string.
cases.weakRepair: Convert every value with String and erase the semantic distinction.

cases.title: Explicit total control flow
cases.target: Every union member receives an explicit branch.
cases.principledRepair: Model alternatives explicitly and handle each branch.
cases.weakRepair: Use a bag of optional fields and guess which one is present.

cases.title: Closure owns private mutable state
cases.target: A closure can preserve state without exposing the variable.
cases.principledRepair: Use closure state when one callable should own the mutation.
cases.weakRepair: Store the counter in a global variable shared by unrelated callers.

cases.title: Callback result contract mismatch
cases.target: The callback must return the type promised by the higher-order function.
cases.principledRepair: Return a number or change the higher-order function contract intentionally.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the string-producing callback to the required function type.

cases.title: Explicit receiver method
cases.target: A method call supplies the object as its receiver.
cases.principledRepair: Call receiver-dependent functions through the owning object or bind them explicitly.
cases.weakRepair: Assume an extracted method remembers its original object.

cases.title: Extracted method loses its receiver
cases.target: A plain function call does not restore the original method receiver.
cases.principledRepair: Use `meter.read()` or bind the method to meter before extraction.
cases.weakRepair: Replace every method with an arrow property without considering allocation or API meaning.

cases.title: Implicit this is not a contract
cases.target: A standalone function has no typed receiver under strict checking.
cases.principledRepair: Declare an explicit `this` parameter or remove receiver dependence.
cases.weakRepair: Disable `noImplicitThis`.

cases.title: Explicit this parameter
cases.target: The pseudo-parameter documents the required receiver without existing at runtime.
cases.principledRepair: State the receiver contract and invoke the function with a matching receiver.
cases.weakRepair: Cast `this` inside the function after untyped access.

cases.title: Variable may be used before assignment
cases.target: Control flow does not guarantee that the closure target was initialized.
cases.principledRepair: Initialize every branch or represent absence explicitly.
cases.weakRepair: Use a definite-assignment assertion and preserve the runtime failure.

cases.title: Bounded callback invocation
cases.target: The higher-order function exposes invocation count as an explicit policy.
cases.principledRepair: Make call budget and stopping rules part of the callable contract.
cases.weakRepair: Invoke the callback speculatively and ignore side effects.

cases.title: Readonly public object view
cases.target: Readonly fields prevent writes through this static view.
cases.principledRepair: Expose readonly views when callers should observe rather than mutate.
cases.weakRepair: Assume readonly recursively freezes all runtime objects.

cases.title: Mutation through readonly field
cases.target: A readonly property cannot be assigned through that type.
cases.principledRepair: Return an updated object when mutation is not part of the API.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the object to a mutable type.

cases.title: Aliases observe the same object
cases.target: Assignment copies an object reference, not the object.
cases.principledRepair: Track identity and mutation explicitly when aliases exist.
cases.weakRepair: Describe assignment as copying the object.

cases.title: Shallow copy does not isolate nested state
cases.target: Object spread copies the nested reference.
cases.principledRepair: Copy each changed path or use a domain operation that owns the update.
cases.weakRepair: Call the top-level spread an immutable deep copy.

cases.title: Readonly array passed to mutating API
cases.target: A readonly array does not satisfy a mutable array parameter.
cases.principledRepair: Copy at the boundary or change the function to return a sorted copy.
cases.weakRepair: Cast away readonly and mutate a caller-owned value.

cases.title: Path-local immutable update
cases.target: Only the changed object path receives new identity.
cases.principledRepair: Copy the changed path and preserve untouched identities.
cases.weakRepair: Deep-clone the entire graph for every small update.

cases.title: Unchecked array element mutation
cases.target: The indexed element may be undefined.
cases.principledRepair: Retrieve, check, and then mutate the element or use a keyed domain operation.
cases.weakRepair: Use `rows[0]!` without an invariant that guarantees the element.

cases.title: Freeze is shallow at runtime
cases.target: `Object.freeze` freezes the supplied object, not every reachable object.
cases.principledRepair: Treat shallow freezing and deep immutability as different contracts.
cases.weakRepair: Claim Object.freeze makes the complete graph immutable.

cases.title: Exhaustive discriminated union
cases.target: A discriminant narrows each state-specific shape.
cases.principledRepair: Use one discriminant and state-specific fields.
cases.weakRepair: Use optional fields and non-null assertions.

cases.title: State-specific field without narrowing
cases.target: Not every union member contains the field.
cases.principledRepair: Narrow on state before reading finishedAt.
cases.weakRepair: Add finishedAt as an optional field to every state.

cases.title: Unknown narrowed by a runtime guard
cases.target: A runtime predicate can establish a local static fact.
cases.principledRepair: Validate the exact property before use.
cases.weakRepair: Assert external data as the desired interface.

cases.title: Property access on unknown
cases.target: Unknown requires proof before property access.
cases.principledRepair: Check object-ness and property type first.
cases.weakRepair: Replace unknown with any.

cases.title: Literal preservation with satisfies
cases.target: `satisfies` checks the wider contract while retaining the literal discriminant.
cases.principledRepair: Use satisfies when both validation and precise inference matter.
cases.weakRepair: Annotate with the broad union and lose the literal unnecessarily.

cases.title: Missing union branch reaches assertNever
cases.target: The unhandled variant is not assignable to never.
cases.principledRepair: Handle the c branch explicitly.
cases.weakRepair: Cast state to never in the default branch.

cases.title: Broad string is not a closed vocabulary
cases.target: An arbitrary string cannot satisfy a finite literal union.
cases.principledRepair: Validate raw against the supported values and narrow it.
cases.weakRepair: Assert raw as Level.

cases.title: Assertion allows impossible runtime state
cases.target: An assertion can forge a union member that runtime data does not satisfy.
cases.principledRepair: Decode unknown data and require text for the message variant.
cases.weakRepair: Add optional chaining and accept malformed events.

cases.title: Generic key index preserves relationships
cases.target: The key parameter is constrained to actual keys of the object.
cases.principledRepair: Express the relationship among object, key, and result.
cases.weakRepair: Return unknown and cast at every call site.

cases.title: Generic result unrelated to input
cases.target: A generic function cannot manufacture an arbitrary T.
cases.principledRepair: Accept a constructor/default or return a concrete known type.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the empty object to T.

cases.title: Map lookup remains optional
cases.target: A missing key produces undefined.
cases.principledRepair: Handle absence or use a helper that establishes the key first.
cases.weakRepair: Use a non-null assertion for every lookup.

cases.title: Duplicate-key policy is observable
cases.target: Building an index requires an explicit duplicate policy.
cases.principledRepair: Reject, merge, or replace duplicates under a named product policy.
cases.weakRepair: Let Map.set silently keep the last row.

cases.title: Stable sorted copy
cases.target: Sorting a copy preserves the source array.
cases.principledRepair: Copy before an in-place algorithm when the source is caller-owned.
cases.weakRepair: Sort the readonly source by casting it to mutable.

cases.title: Reduce accumulator type mismatch
cases.target: The reducer result must match the accumulator type.
cases.principledRepair: Return a number from every reducer step or choose a string accumulator.
cases.weakRepair: Cast each intermediate result to number.

cases.title: Deterministic grouping order
cases.target: A sorted key list separates grouping from presentation order.
cases.principledRepair: Define presentation order independently from insertion accidents.
cases.weakRepair: Assume every producer inserts Map keys in the same order.

cases.title: Generic predicate keeps element type
cases.target: The generic relationship does not erase the element.
cases.principledRepair: Preserve T from source through callback to result.
cases.weakRepair: Use any for callback values and return values.

cases.title: Explicit JavaScript import specifier
cases.target: NodeNext resolves a .js output specifier to the TypeScript source during checking.
cases.principledRepair: Write the specifier that emitted ESM will load.
cases.weakRepair: Use extensionless imports that only a bundler understands.

cases.title: Extensionless relative ESM import
cases.target: NodeNext requires explicit output extensions for relative ESM imports.
cases.principledRepair: Import `./value.js` from TypeScript source.
cases.weakRepair: Switch module resolution to a bundler mode while still claiming direct Node execution.

cases.title: Type-only module edge
cases.target: A type-only import creates no runtime dependency.
cases.principledRepair: Use import type when only the static declaration is needed.
cases.weakRepair: Import a runtime module and depend on elision heuristics.

cases.title: Type-only name used at runtime
cases.target: The imported interface is erased.
cases.principledRepair: Use User only as a type or export a real runtime constructor/value.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the erased name through any.

cases.title: Named export has no default
cases.target: A module with only named exports does not provide a default export.
cases.principledRepair: Use `import { answer }` or deliberately add a default export.
cases.weakRepair: Enable synthetic defaults and obscure the actual module contract.

cases.title: Re-exported public surface
cases.target: A package entry module can expose a deliberate subset.
cases.principledRepair: Re-export only the intended public value.
cases.weakRepair: Export every internal module through a wildcard barrel.

cases.title: Live ESM binding
cases.target: Imported ESM bindings observe updates made by the exporting module.
cases.principledRepair: Understand exports as live bindings rather than copied values.
cases.weakRepair: Assume every import is a frozen snapshot.

cases.title: Circular initialization hazard avoided by contract
cases.target: Acyclic module ownership makes initialization order explainable.
cases.principledRepair: Move shared primitives to a lower-level module and keep dependencies acyclic.
cases.weakRepair: Rely on circular initialization timing and patch undefined values.

cases.title: Unknown configuration validation
cases.target: Runtime checks establish a trusted local configuration.
cases.principledRepair: Validate the exact runtime shape and value constraints.
cases.weakRepair: Declare JSON.parse to return Config.

cases.title: Unknown catch value property access
cases.target: Catch variables are unknown under strict checking.
cases.principledRepair: Use `error instanceof Error` before reading message.
cases.weakRepair: Change the catch variable to any.

cases.title: Unsafe configuration assertion
cases.target: A static assertion cannot create the missing runtime property.
cases.principledRepair: Decode unknown data and reject null output before property access.
cases.weakRepair: Wrap access in try/catch and continue with an incomplete configuration.

cases.title: Error narrowed before causal wrapping
cases.target: Runtime narrowing preserves the original cause safely.
cases.principledRepair: Narrow unknown failures and preserve cause when crossing layers.
cases.weakRepair: Assume all thrown values are Error instances.

cases.title: Exact optional property rejects explicit undefined
cases.target: An optional string property means absent or string, not explicitly undefined.
cases.principledRepair: Omit note when absent or declare `string | undefined` deliberately.
cases.weakRepair: Disable exactOptionalPropertyTypes.

cases.title: Absent optional property omitted
cases.target: Omission matches the declared optional contract.
cases.principledRepair: Represent absence through omission when that is the contract.
cases.weakRepair: Populate every optional field with undefined.

cases.title: Validation result requires narrowing
cases.target: The error variant has no value field.
cases.principledRepair: Check result.ok before reading value.
cases.weakRepair: Add value as optional to the failure variant.

cases.title: Collected validation issues
cases.target: Independent field errors can be accumulated without manufacturing a value.
cases.principledRepair: Collect independent issues and construct no trusted value until prerequisites pass.
cases.weakRepair: Return a partially valid object with fallback fields.

cases.title: Promise reaction ordering
cases.target: Promise reactions run after the synchronous stack and before a zero-delay timer.
cases.principledRepair: Predict ordering by queue and scheduling contract.
cases.weakRepair: Describe async callbacks as simply running later.

cases.title: Async function return annotation
cases.target: An async function returns a Promise.
cases.principledRepair: Annotate Promise<number> or omit the annotation and inspect inference.
cases.weakRepair: Remove async while keeping asynchronous operations inside.

cases.title: Forgotten await changes the value type
cases.target: The call produces Promise<number>, not number.
cases.principledRepair: Await inside an async boundary or return the promise to the caller.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the promise to number.

cases.title: Promise.all preserves tuple positions
cases.target: A const tuple lets Promise.all retain positional result types.
cases.principledRepair: Use tuple inference when positions have different contracts.
cases.weakRepair: Treat the result as any[].

cases.title: Rejected top-level operation
cases.target: A promise rejection is represented in the async return type, not prevented by it.
cases.principledRepair: Observe or propagate every promise according to ownership.
cases.weakRepair: Prefix every promise with void and ignore rejections.

cases.title: AbortSignal is an explicit input
cases.target: Cancellation is part of the function contract rather than hidden global state.
cases.principledRepair: Pass cancellation through the operations that own cancellable work.
cases.weakRepair: Check one global boolean occasionally.

cases.title: Callback API does not return a promise
cases.target: The callback-based readFile overload returns void.
cases.principledRepair: Use node:fs/promises or wrap the callback API exactly once.
cases.weakRepair: Cast void to Promise<string>.

cases.title: Promise filesystem boundary
cases.target: The promise API composes with await and typed rejection propagation.
cases.principledRepair: Use the promise-based boundary when the application is promise-oriented.
cases.weakRepair: Mix callbacks and promises at every call site.

cases.title: Dependency shape supports deterministic testing
cases.target: A minimal dependency contract lets tests supply controlled effects.
cases.principledRepair: Inject the smallest nondeterministic capability.
cases.weakRepair: Mock the global Date constructor across the whole process.

cases.title: Missing return path
cases.target: `noImplicitReturns` requires every reachable path to return.
cases.principledRepair: Handle zero and negative values explicitly.
cases.weakRepair: Add `return undefined as unknown as string`.

cases.title: Fake implements the real boundary
cases.target: A test double should satisfy the same narrow interface as production.
cases.principledRepair: Define the boundary around observable behavior and implement it in the fake.
cases.weakRepair: Give tests a different helper API than production uses.

cases.title: Test oracle detects a violated invariant
cases.target: A test should fail when the claimed invariant is false.
cases.principledRepair: Create a new object when the contract promises immutable history.
cases.weakRepair: Delete the assertion because the code otherwise runs.

cases.title: Mock has the wrong asynchronous signature
cases.target: The fake must return the promise required by the real dependency.
cases.principledRepair: Return Promise.resolve() or use an async function.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the fake as Store.

cases.title: Exhaustive application result
cases.target: A closed result union lets the shell render every outcome deliberately.
cases.principledRepair: Keep the result vocabulary closed and render each variant.
cases.weakRepair: Return arbitrary objects and inspect properties dynamically.

cases.title: Readonly dependency cannot be replaced
cases.target: A readonly dependency property is stable after construction.
cases.principledRepair: Construct a new application dependency object for a different test.
cases.weakRepair: Cast the property to mutable and alter a shared fixture.

cases.title: Orchestration preserves effect order
cases.target: Await establishes the required save-before-report sequence.
cases.principledRepair: Await the committing effect before emitting success.
cases.weakRepair: Start save and immediately report success.
